title: Xdrip Prefs unfortunately stopped
body:
I'm using Samsung S9 with Xdrip+ in follower mode, build from 2019-10-27, and a Sony SW3.
I've been plagued with error message "Xdrip Prefs has unfortunately stopped" on the watch, more than 10 times a day, up to the point where it was becoming ridiculous.
Fortunately I managed to find a (sort of) solution which in any case should help locate the error. I (for some unknown reason) switched from Swedish to English settings and the problem was gone!
I've now been on English for about a week and haven't had a single error message.
